qa_pairs.question: Why do temporary output files from STAR-CCM+ jobs accumulate and consume quota space?
qa_pairs.answer: Temporary output files from STAR-CCM+ jobs may accumulate in hidden directories named `~/.star-version_number`, which can consume valuable quota space.

qa_pairs.question: How can users remove the temporary output files generated by STAR-CCM+ jobs?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can remove temporary output files from STAR-CCM+ jobs by periodically running the command `rm -ri ~/.starccm*` and replying 'yes' when prompted.
